description: MUTATES YouCanBookMe data: adds a location to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/locations (JSON). Required: kind (location type) and strategy (how it is assigned). Use the `fields` passthrough for value, notes, and other documented fields. The path profileId is never sent in the body.

fields.description: Additional documented YCBM fields to send in the JSON write body — merged OVER the typed fields above.

profileId.description: The profile (booking page) id (path only; required).

value.description: The location value (e.g. an address or link).

name: create_location
title: Add a location
